entity_geography.text: Visit Requests / Base Access: As required by the SOW and DAFFARS 5352.2049000, notify the 42d Air Base Wing Information Protection Office 30 days before on‑base performance. Use DISS for Visit Requests (SMO Code: MG0JFFQD6). REAL ID requirements apply for base access. Condition: Services must be provided by authorized technicians and in accordance with the SOW. All replaced parts must be removed and properly disposed of by the contractor. SAM Registration: To be eligible for award, contractor MUST BE REGISTERED and ACTIVE in the DOW System for Award Management (SAM) database at time of quotation submission. No exceptions. Contractors not registered in SAM, your quote will not be evaluated. To register, please visit http://www.sam.gov or call 1-866-606-8220. Responses to this notice shall be provided in writing via e-mail to the Contract Specialist, 2d Lt Sage Law, (334) 953-7758, sage.law.2@us.af.mil and the Contracting Officer, MSgt Jeremy Rash, (334) 953-3913, jeremy.rash@us.af.mil. All responses shall be received by 01:00 pm CDT on 24 August 2026. Email is the preferred method of contact. Upon receipt of your quote, the Government will confirm receipt within 24 hours. If a confirmation has not been received within 24 hours, please contact the Contract Specialist and Contracting Office
